chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Asami narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymi from Ali ibn Asbaat from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Jameel ibn Darraj who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When the slave marries the free woman, so his children are free, and when the free man marries the slave woman, so his children are free.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children when one parent is a slave and the other is free?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freedom of the offspring' (hurriyyat al-walad) in mixed-status marriages, ensuring that children inherit the higher status of the free parent. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is foundational for determining the social and legal standing of individuals in early Islamic society, particularly regarding the emancipation of concubines (ummi al-walad) and their children. It reflects the Quranic ethic of gradual emancipation and the dignity of the free-born.
